title: Day 3 Intelligence
subtitle: First responders, basement entry, and resuscitation
one_liner: Police, fire, and medical responders supplied overlapping but distinct accounts of arrival, scene access, the children, and emergency care.
purpose: Organize the responder sequence while preserving each witness's vantage point, estimates, and actions as separate testimony.
what_changed: The record gained multiple firsthand accounts of the exterior and basement scenes, the children's locations and conditions, and resuscitation efforts.
